summary: Iter45 backend + frontend tests. 11/15 backend tests pass. 2 real backend bugs found: (1) pro PDF export route collision causes 404, (2) admin support-resolve notification stored as ObjectId but get_notifications queries by string -> user can't see toast. Frontend MyQuotes complaints tab + report-problem triggers + Won bucket + Admin Invoicing 6-pill ScrollSnapTabStrip + Online Payments table + Invoice Data 3 template cards + MyInvoices export-all-pdf button + sonner Toaster all verified working.

critical.issue: Returns 404 "Invoice not found" instead of merged PDF. Route collision: pro_invoicing_router (registered first in server.py L51-58) has /{invoice_id} which matches 'export.pdf' as the invoice_id before iter45_pro_router gets a chance. Fix: move iter45_pro_router include ABOVE pro_invoicing_router OR register /export.pdf inside pro_invoicing_routes.py BEFORE the /{invoice_id} route.

Notification IS inserted in db.notifications but with user_id stored as ObjectId (feedback_routes.py L277-278). However GET /api/notifications (misc_routes.py L457) queries with user_id=user["_id"] which is a STRING (auth.py L70 stringifies it). Result: notification never surfaces to the pro -> no in-app toast. Fix: insert notification user_id as str(existing["user_id"]) to match the rest of the codebase.

rca_of_the_issue.pro_pdf_export_404: FastAPI matches routes in inclusion order. pro_invoicing_router is included BEFORE iter45_pro_router (both prefix=/pro-invoices). pro_invoicing has @router.get('/{invoice_id}') at line 230 — this catches 'export.pdf' as the path parameter, the handler tries ObjectId('export.pdf') -> fails -> raises 404. The newly-added /export.pdf in iter45_pro_router is never reached. Reproduction: curl https://<base>/api/pro-invoices/export.pdf with pro cookies -> {detail:'Invoice not found'}. Mitigation: change include order in server.py.
rca_of_the_issue.missing_notification: feedback_routes admin_update_support inserts {user_id: ObjectId(...)} into db.notifications. But misc_routes.get_notifications queries db.notifications.find({user_id: user['_id']}) where user['_id'] = str(...) (set in auth.py L70). String != ObjectId in Mongo, so the new notification is invisible. Existing notifications (e.g. quote_routes.create_notification) pass a STRING user_id, which is why other kinds like 'location_shared' work. Mitigation: change feedback_routes.py L277-278 to: 'user_id': str(existing['user_id']).
